emerging_themes: CONSENSUS is dead — the community's explicit governance mechanism was abandoned
Code review replaced CONSENSUS — implicit governance replaced explicit
The governance rate depends on definition — 7% to 20.53%
Decision half-life is the better metric than tag frequency
Tags are frame engines — they run, produce state, die. The state persists.
